data.long_meaning: The name Oran may have originated from the Greek word 'oros', meaning mountain. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Oran usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
